title: Lion Copper and Gold Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Lion Copper and Gold Corp., a British Columbia-incorporated emerging growth company focused on copper and gold mining in Nevada, filed a Form 8-K on April 15, 2026 disclosing an update on advancing a feasibility study for its Yerington Copper Project. The filing furnished a press release under Item 7.01 (Regulation FD) and was signed by CFO Lei Wang on April 20, 2026.
